seo.shareDescription: Validation data and arterial-line comparison for continuous, noninvasive blood pressure monitoring.

hero.title: Beat-to-beat accuracy,
hero.body: VeriTrack has been validated across 300+ operating room patients at 6+ academic and community hospital sites. In direct comparison against the invasive radial arterial line, the clinical gold standard for continuous pressure, VeriTrack tracked beat-to-beat hemodynamic changes across a wide range of patients and surgical cases.

validation.title: Operating room
validation.body: Our validation program spans 6+ academic and community hospital sites, including UC Irvine, University of Vermont Medical Center, UCSF, and Henry Ford, with studies comparing VeriTrack directly against the invasive radial arterial line in OR patients undergoing general anesthesia. The validation follows AAMI ISO 81060-2 methodology for comparison against an arterial reference. Data from our design-freeze studies demonstrate accuracy within ISO 81060-3 standards. In cases where the arterial line dropped signal due to clotting or required repeated flushing, VeriTrack maintained a clean continuous trace. Full study results are forthcoming.
